_about: v2.2 Neutral rework, unit N4 — the REVIEWED expectations for every card the rework has changed so far (N1–N3 carried over unchanged; N4 adds Rapid Fire's five tiers — T1–T4 attack speed as rate ratios, T5 the chaos beam with its R4 tier gates — and the copy-only Warp Shot / Mirror Edge records naming the beam's inertness, per R2/R4), grounded in docs/v2.2-neutral-design-spec.md §2 and N0 §4 R3/R4. The frozen legacy fixtures are never edited; ParityAttribution builds the expected current documents from them plus this overlay. `cards` = dump-shaped records of every card whose AUTHORED record changed; `expectedDeltas` = the reviewed PlayerStats effects of the cards whose EFFECT changed (a card in `cards` with no entry here changed copy only); `addedFields` = stored fields that did not exist in the legacy record. Supersedes n3-overlay.json (kept as evidence). `multiplicativeFields` (v2.2 N4) = fields every writer of which MULTIPLIES; ParityAttribution shifts them by ratio, grounded in the record's own constant ratio per tier.
fieldsNote: N1: Swift adds its rungs to moveSpeedMultiplier (0.08, 0.12, 0.15); Magnetic Core adds its rungs to pickupRadiusMultiplier (0.15, 0.15, 0.20) and SETS magneticCoreSpeedBoost (0.10, 0.20, 0.30); Keen Eye's +0.20 radius is gone. N2: XP Boost adds its rungs to xpMultiplier (0.25, 0.25, 0.00) and at T3 sets runLevelCap 15 → 20 and adds 1 to grantedLevelsPending. Overclock's effect (overclockActive) is unchanged; its +35% attack speed / +15% damage are computed properties read while its timer runs, not stored fields. N3: Long Shot adds its rungs to projectileRangeMultiplier (0.25, 0.25, 0, 0) and sets longShotTier 1–4; Scatter adds lanes−1 to extraProjectiles (1, 1, 2, 4) and sets scatterTier 1–4 — it no longer adds 0.15 to spreadAngle (the legacy T1 did; spreadAngle now only shapes the no-Scatter legacy cone); Fracture Shot sets fractureTier 1–4 and no longer writes splitCount (the v1.8 split fields are retired: unread, unwritten, still stored so the accepted engine compiles against the current PlayerStats). N4: Rapid Fire's T1–T4 multiply fireRateMultiplier by rate ratios 1/1.10, 1.10/1.25, 1.25/1.50, 1.50/1.90 (legacy: ×0.90 once) and set rapidFireTier 1–4; T5 sets rapidFireTier 5 (the beam) and leaves the rate.
addedFieldsNote: PlayerStats stored fields introduced in N2 (the run level cap and XP Boost's owed level). They appear in fieldPaths/defaultState and change only through XP Boost T3.

neutral_1.name: Swift
neutral_1.detail: Permanent movement speed: +8%, then +20%, then +35% (totals). Adds to your other movement bonuses.

v13_magnetic_core.name: Magnetic Core
v13_magnetic_core.description: +15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst
v13_magnetic_core.detail: XP orbs are pulled from 15% / 30% / 50% farther (totals). Each XP orb collected grants +10% / +20% / +30% movement speed for 1.5s; another pickup refreshes the time, never the strength. Health orbs are never magnetized.

neutral_5.name: XP Boost
neutral_5.detail: Run XP gain: +25%, then +50% (totals). The run's level cap is 15; tier 3 raises it to 20 and grants one full level-up right away (card and stat), keeping the XP you have. XP collected at the cap is banked.

v17_overclock.name: Overclock
v17_overclock.detail: After each level-up, when play resumes: +35% movement speed, +35% attack speed and +15% damage for 3 seconds of play. Another level-up refreshes the time; it never stacks.

neutral_4.name: Long Shot
neutral_4.detail: Shot range: +25%, then +50% (totals). Tier 3: shots never expire by distance. Tier 4: unlimited range, and shots pierce every enemy and pass through walls and terrain. Adds to your other range bonuses.
tierDescriptions: No limit; pierce all, pass walls

neutral_6.name: Scatter
neutral_6.detail: Every volley fires 2 parallel shots, then 3 (center and one to each side), then 5, then 9 across a wide fan. Each is a full-strength shot with all your shot effects. Storm Engine's bonus pellets add lanes to the same pattern.

v18_fracture_shot.name: Fracture Shot
v18_fracture_shot.detail: Each shot splits into 3 branches over 30°, then 5 over 60°, 9 over 120°, 17 over 180°. The shot's damage is shared evenly across all its branches (the center included); several branches can hit one enemy. Fans never spread past 90° to either side.

neutral_3.name: Rapid Fire
neutral_3.detail: Attack speed: +10%, then +25%, +50%, +90% (totals). Tier 5 turns your shots into a continuous chaos beam: it pierces enemies, stops at walls, and deals 75% of your shot damage every 0.5s, scaled up by all your attack speed. Scatter and Fracture split the beam. Warp Shot and Mirror Edge don't affect the beam; Erasure's Echo re-fires each beam lane as a normal shot. Can't be combined with Polar Vortex's icicle.

void_1.description: Slow shots that speed up. Slower = more damage.
void_1.detail: Your primary shots launch at 40% speed and reach full speed after 0.6s. They deal 150% damage at launch, falling to 100% at full speed. No effect on Rapid Fire's chaos beam. Damage between whole numbers rounds up by chance.
void_1.name: Warp Shot

v18_mirror_edge.description: Shots have a 35% chance to echo for 50% damage.
v18_mirror_edge.detail: Each primary shot has a 35% chance to fire again 0.15s later for 50% damage. No effect on Rapid Fire's chaos beam. Echoes don't echo, split or leave pull zones, and aren't primary hits.
v18_mirror_edge.name: Mirror Edge

expectedDeltasNote: Pairs are from the DEFAULT state (byte for byte); from a mid-run state the same per-tier CHANGE is required. XP Boost T3's xpMultiplier rung is +0.00 (T3 keeps +50%), so it does not appear in T3's diff; T3's cap is a max() to 20 and the granted level is += 1. N3: Long Shot T3/T4 add +0 range (totals stay +50%), so only longShotTier appears in their diffs. N4: Rapid Fire's fireRateMultiplier pairs are from the default state; from a mid-run state the same per-tier RATIO is required (a multiplicative field). Warp Shot and Mirror Edge are copy-only rewrites (their effects equal the legacy record exactly).

retiredNotes.neutral_2: v2.2 N1 Neutral (Keen Eye, merged into Magnetic Core)
